name: Landlocked: Chuck Log
source:
Finally freed of the life that shackled him so fiercely, Chuck wastes no time trying to live the thrill of a gainer lifestyle. He finally finds someone who seems pleasant after trudging through beginners with their heads up their ass and their egos even deeper.

Why? Because Chuck is no ordinary divorced man discovering their fetish as a happenstance born out of isolation and far too much free time. He has tangoed with this scene before, and after years of absence, he's more than ready to relive his wild, unrestrained youth.

Now all he has to do is hope that neither he nor his date fuck it up. Seems like easy enough, but you never know... 

[From [url=https://foxglove-vn-productions.itch.io/land-locked-chuck-log]Itch.io[/url]]
